Question: How many orders contain items from more than one seller?
text:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_with_multiple_sellers
FROM (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) > 1
);

This counts how many orders have items from more than one seller.
reasoning: We need to answer: "How many orders contain items from more than one seller?" We have orders table, order_items table with seller_id. We need to count orders where distinct seller_id count > 1. So query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) > 1). That returns number of orders. Use SQLite. Provide explanation. Ensure only SELECT. Provide final answer.
